title: QL-1.02 Mutation gate: the changed lines are broken on purpose and the tests must catch every mutant
request: Closes quality-loop principle 2 (a test that survives a mutation is a weak test). Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-0.03. Quality-loop principle set of 30 October 2026 (owner's order: implement as a gate for all dev).

tasks.title: Mutation runner over the diff
requirements: scripts/gate/mutate.mjs takes --base <sha> and --test <cmd>, lists the lines added or changed between base and the working tree in src/**/*.mjs, and applies one mutation at a time from a fixed operator set: === and !==, < and >=, > and <=, && and ||, true and false, + and - on numeric operands, a return value replaced by undefined, a call statement removed

before any mutant it runs the test command twice on the unmutated tree; a failure or a differing pass count there is NOISE and the run stops with exit 2, never judging a mutant (the twin's ME-MT oracle was confounded without this control)
each mutant runs in a temporary copy of the workdir that is removed in a finally block; the original tree is byte-identical after the run (checked by hashing the scope files before and after)

--json prints {status, mutants, killed, survived, invalid, timeout, ignored, noise, survivors:[{file,line,operator}], unmutated:[{file,line}]}; exit 1 when any mutant survives; a line carrying the comment mutate-ignore with a reason is skipped and counted as ignored
the script has no dependencies and its first line carries a version: comment
a NOISE run and a run with zero mutants never report survived 0 as a result: --json carries status (ok, noise, no-mutants or error) and the survived value counts only when status is ok
a mutant counts as killed only when two runs of the test command on it both fail; a mutant whose two runs disagree stops the run with exit 2 and status noise

mutants counts judged mutants only, so mutants equals killed + survived; invalid, timeout and ignored mutants have their own counts; a run that judged no mutant exits non-zero with status no-mutants and no numeric survived

the operator set also covers: a call used as a condition negated, a ! removed, a throw statement removed, a bare return; removed, ?? replaced by ||, += and -= swapped, ++ and -- swapped, and an awaited call statement removed; --json lists under unmutated every changed line that produced no mutant

each run creates its own temporary directory with fs.mkdtempSync under os.tmpdir(), mode 0700, never a fixed path, and removes it in a finally block and on SIGINT and SIGTERM; two concurrent runs never share a copy
a --base that is empty, does not resolve to a commit, or begins with '-' stops the run with exit 2 and status error before any test runs

before judging mutants the run applies a no-op change (a trailing comment on one changed line) and runs the test command once; a failure there shows the tests react to the diff itself, and the run stops with exit 2 and status noise
every test command runs with HOME set to a fresh directory inside the run's temporary directory and MEMEV_NO_SERVICE=1, so a mutant's tests never touch the caller's home or register a service

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/gate-mutate.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T1-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest

criteria.statement: On a fixture whose test checks the changed comparison the mutant is killed; on a fixture whose test only checks that a function returns, the mutant survives and the run exits 1; a flaky fixture stops with NOISE before any mutant

tasks.title: Every code contract carries the mutation criterion
requirements: the mutation lint warns at memev contract new, from-request, amend and decompose when an implement task whose scope includes src/** lacks the canonical mutation criteria: three mandatory metrics on one canonical scripts/gate/mutate.mjs command, survived == 0, mutants > 0 and ignored == 0
docs/CONTRACTS.md shows the three criteria to copy and states that a test that survives a mutation is a weak test

the lint is engine code in src/engine/mutation-lint.mjs, called by contractDraft, contractFromRequest, contractAmend, contractDecompose (with the scope's workdir when it names one) and contractSign; the vendored attest code is unchanged, because the checks need the workdir's project test command and vendored code cannot import the engine

with the vault setting contracts.mutation_required on, memev contract sign and the MCP sign tool refuse, with a ContractError naming the mutation criterion, a draft whose src-touching implement task has any mutation lint finding, and write no signed contract; whether the workdir holds scripts/gate/mutate.mjs plays no part; the setting is off by default because the gate does not ship in the package, and the warning text names the setting

the canonical command is node scripts/gate/mutate.mjs --base "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" --test "<T>" --json, with <T> either projectTestCommand(workdir) or node --test followed only by paths matching test/**/*.test.mjs (a listed subset can only leave more survivors than the full suite); the lint compares shell tokens, so an appended command, a redirection, a pipe, a repeated flag or a literal base is a finding
